message.content: On May 14, 2026, Li Hua and Wolfgang visited a restaurant together for dinner. According to the conversation, Li Hua particularly enjoyed the pasta dish they had, describing it as "rich and flavorful." Wolfgang also had a positive experience, enjoying the steak he ordered. While Wolfgang suggested that the dessert was a "nice treat," Li Hua was not explicit about what he liked specifically from the dessert menu. However, based on their conversation, both participants found the meal enjoyable and expressed a desire to return to the restaurant sometime in the future.
